title: MixLID: Token-Level Language Identification in Mixed-Language Text
abstract: arXiv:2610.16601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Processing multilingual text requires both identifying a broad range of languages and distinguishing the language of each token in inputs containing multiple languages. We introduce MixLID, a token-level language identification model supporting 111 language-script combinations. MixLID follows a two-stage training process: it first learns to distinguish individual languages using the language labels of monolingual examples, then continues training on mixed-language data. The second stage uses concatenated examples from existing code-switching data alongside augmented examples created through word substitution based on correspondences between English source words and loanwords. For monolingual identification, MixLID outperforms all baselines in both accuracy and macro F1 on four benchmarks within the language coverage shared with each baseline. translated_title: MixLID：混合语言文本中的词元级语言识别
translated_abstract: 处理多语言文本既需要识别广泛的语言范围，又需要在包含多种语言的输入中区分每个词元所属的语言。我们提出了MixLID，一个支持111种语言-文字组合的词元级语言识别模型。MixLID采用两阶段训练过程：首先利用单语样本的语言标签学习区分各个语言，然后在混合语言数据上继续训练。第二阶段使用来自现有语码转换数据的拼接样本，以及通过基于英语源词与借词之间对应关系的词语替换所构建的增强样本。在单语识别方面，MixLID在与各基线共享的语言覆盖范围内的四个基准测试上，其准确率和宏F1分数均超越了所有基线模型。在混合语言识别方面，它在识别各词元语言的表现上也超越了基线模型。
tldr: 提出了支持111种语言-文字组合的词元级语言识别模型MixLID，通过先单语识别、后混合语言数据训练的两阶段方法，在单语和混合语言识别任务上均超越了现有基线。
